The '''Highland Lakes''' was a prosperous region located along the equator of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]]. Connected to the populated regions of [[Vossport/Legends|Vossport]] and [[Fume/Legends|Fume]] by a long road that ran through the [[Madlands]], Highland Lakes was geographically close to the [[Sunrace Citadel]].<ref name="NoP" />
